calibration.separation: No exact/normalized, available scoped group, or cosine>=0.90 overlap. Historical document/person lineage is missing; semantic independence is not proven.

contextual.memory_scope: Python tracemalloc only; excludes native allocators and Ollama process/GPU

frozen_baseline.memory_scope: Python tracemalloc only; excludes native allocators and Ollama process/GPU

benchmark.scope: Ten identical single-request inputs, warm services; includes contextual HTTP/encoder/head overhead. Not cold-start or concurrent throughput.

contextual.comparability: Frozen artifact lineage unverified. Matched TF-IDF control and contextual head use the same 60-row development recipe and same evaluation texts. Development exposure prevents independent winner selection.

limitations: All data is development-exposed or has uncertain source independence. No holdout read. Artifact training manifest is absent; the control model provides a matched experimental training recipe, not proof of artifact lineage.

robustness.limitations: Generated correlated probes, not independent evidence. Masked cases have unknown ground truth and are excluded from binary metrics. Credential withholding is separate from privacy labels.
